description: Pinned prebuilt WebAssembly modules and their Emscripten glue. The root build (npm run build) copies and embeds these exact files; it never compiles native code. Rebuild route: scripts/build-wasm.ps1 with the toolchain recorded in toolchain-pin.json. The glue and the WebAssembly contain upstream Emscripten, musl libc, LLVM libc++ and dlmalloc code under their own licenses (EMSCRIPTEN-LICENSE.txt, MUSL-COPYRIGHT.txt, LIBCXX-LICENSE.txt, DLMALLOC-NOTICE.txt); they are not relicensed. The compiler toolchain is identified in toolchain-pin.json but is not redistributed.
